manifest.description: Broadcast Music Assistant audio over Bluetooth LE Audio Auracast.

serial_port.label: Serial port
serial_port.description: UART device used by the Bumble Bluetooth controller.

baudrate.label: Serial baud rate
baudrate.description: UART baud rate used by the Bluetooth controller.

broadcast_name.label: Broadcast name
broadcast_name.description: Name shown to nearby Auracast receivers.

advertising_rate.label: Advertising rate
advertising_rate.description: How often the broadcast announces itself to receivers. Fast (60 ms) lets receivers find and join the broadcast sooner. Slow (150 ms) uses less airtime and power and leaves more room for other Bluetooth traffic.

manufacturer_data.label: Manufacturer data
manufacturer_data.description: Optional company ID and hex payload as ID:HEX. Separate multiple entries with semicolons.
